title: Describe an Accessory or Piece of Clothing You Like
prompts: 1. What is the accessory or clothing item?
2. What is it made of? (Use 'made of')
3. Where did you get it? Who gave it to you?
4. How long have you had it? What do you like about it?
model: My favorite accessory is a silver bracelet. It is made of real silver and has a beautiful striped pattern. My grandmother gave it to me as a gift for my birthday two years ago. I have had it for two years, and I wear it on special occasions. I like it because it reminds me of my grandmother and it looks elegant with any outfit.
